name: ET Susanoo Itachi (S)
description: Having been reanimated once more, Itachi now manifests the full power of his Susanoo in battle. Shielded by the Yata Mirror and wielding the sealing Totsuka Blade, he becomes a relentless force that blends absolute defense with lethal precision.

skills.name: Skeletal Blade
skills.description: Using his Susanoo's skeletal blade, Itachi deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy. Permanently, that enemy will receive 5 additional damage from harmful skills.

skills.name: Interrupting Slice
skills.description: Itachi deals 15 piercing damage to one enemy. Permanently, that enemy will deal 5 less non-affliction damage.

skills.name: Totsuka Blade Sealing
skills.description: Itachi seals one enemy with his Susanoo's legendary blade, dealing 35 affliction damage to them, removing 1 bloodline or genjutsu chakra and stunning their harmful skills for 1 turn. This skill cannot be countered or reflected.

skills.name: Edo Tensei Susanoo
skills.description: For 3 turns, if Itachi's health drops to 35 or less, Itachi's Susanoo will evolve to the next stage, improving his skills for the following 3 turns. During this time, this skill will be replaced by 'Yasaka Magatama' and Itachi's skills will steal health instead. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Yasaka Magatama
skills.description: Itachi unleashes his strongest long-range technique, dealing 40 piercing damage to all enemies. This skill cannot be countered.
